ai.name: AI app (Claude)
ai.desc: Your knowledge base gets pulled into conversations, and what you learn there comes back as drafts.

smartSearch.name: Smart search
smartSearch.desc: Finds notes by meaning, even when the wording differs. Just turn it on — nothing leaves your machine (a one-time ~560MB download).

backup.name: Backup
backup.desc: Back up notes and files marked for full sync to a private repository, then restore them on your other devices. Local-only files never leave this device.
backup.done: Backup destination set, and the first copy has been sent
